summary: This project's own felling-axe attacks, as key poses for tools/anim_author/pose_solver.gd: body space, the body facing +Z, its left +X, metres and degrees (a measured clip's turns of the tool and the hands as quaternions, its tool and elbows in the chest's frame: "space"). Keys are eased into as "ease" says (spline: a curve through the keys either side). Clips with "fit" had their keys measured off the reference swing named there (tools/anim_author/fit_ref.gd, owner's request 2026-09-27: as close to the reference as possible): those key poses are a copy of the reference's at those moments, only the in-betweens are the solver's own.

axe_d.desc: D: right to left, level at the chest

axe_a.desc: A: left to right, level at the chest (our own D mirrored: two-handed)

axe_stab.desc: the felling axe's stab (W/S + A/D): a one-handed underhand thrust of the head straight ahead
axe_stab.authored: keyed by hand (tools/anim_author/author_thrust.gd), a one-handed lunge, held as the axe's carry holds it

club_stab.desc: the musket clubbed's stab (W/S + A/D): a one-handed underhand thrust of the butt straight ahead
club_stab.authored: keyed by hand (tools/anim_author/author_thrust.gd), a one-handed lunge, held as the club's guard holds it with its right hand

axe_parry.desc: the parry (A+D): a two-handed sweep of the haft across the chest, knocking a thrust aside
axe_parry.authored: keyed by hand (tools/anim_author/author_parry.gd) from the D swing's guard

axe_block_high.desc: S: the high block, the haft held across above the head in both hands against W's chop
axe_block_high.authored: keyed by hand (tools/anim_author/author_high_block.gd) from the D swing's guard
